title: Microsoft Purview: Diagnostics open to Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management
summary: The roadmap details and the documented diagnostics largely check out. However, the statement that nothing needs configuring is not established, and the instructions for reviewing Entra roles omit the Global Administrator requirement for viewing that section of Purview.

claims.claim: Purview role-group membership is managed at Settings > Roles and scopes > Role groups > role group > Edit > Choose users.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the arrival default or a required administrator action for this specific access expansion.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview self-help diagnostics 500396 automatic rollout no action required Organization Management; Purview Diagnostics Organization Management default enable disable. Read the roadmap and self-help diagnostics page; neither specifies this item's arrival default.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: A Diagnostics-specific licence requirement is not yet published, so the licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview self-help diagnostics license pricing prerequisites. Opened self-help diagnostics and Purview service description; searched the latter for diagnostic (no matches). It gives general licensing obligations but no Diagnostics-specific entitlement.
claims.fix: Keep the Diagnostics-specific gap, but add to licensing.notes and Cost and licensing: 'Microsoft's Purview service description says users with a Purview role assigned for use in the portal require a licence; a Diagnostics-specific entitlement is not yet published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-purview-service-description.

claims.claim: The self-help diagnostics page lists role requirements, but no licence prerequisite for running Diagnostics.

claims.claim: Self-help Purview diagnostics run from Solutions pages and the Help pane.

claims.claim: Information Protection Solutions diagnostics require Compliance Administrator or Security Administrator.
claims.quote: To run the Information Protection diagnostics, you need to have either of the following roles: Compliance Administrator; Security Administrator
claims.fix: After the current role requirements, add: 'Another Microsoft Learn page at https://learn.microsoft.com/troubleshoot/microsoft-365/diagnostics/purview-compliance-diagnostics still says Solutions diagnostics require a Microsoft 365 global administrator.' Cite that page as well; do not replace the current requirements.

claims.claim: DLP Solutions diagnostics accept Compliance Administrator and Security Administrator among their roles.
claims.quote: To run the DLP diagnostics, you need to have any of the following roles: Compliance Administrator; Security Administrator; Organization Configuration; View-Only Configuration; Security Reader

claims.claim: Help diagnostics for DLP policy and rule configuration, Sensitivity label configuration and Validate Audit configuration list Global admin as their minimum role.
claims.quote: DLP policy and rule configuration ... Global admin ... Sensitivity label configuration ... Global admin ... Validate Audit configuration ... Global Admin

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not identify which diagnostics specifically gain access through roadmap item 500396.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview self-help diagnostics 500396 automatic rollout no action required Organization Management; Purview Diagnostics Organization Management default enable disable. claims.claim: Diagnostics inspect Purview tenant configuration through cmdlets including Get-DlpCompliancePolicy and Get-label.
claims.quote: the diagnostic runs the Check-PurviewConfig cmdlet to check your organization's configuration settings in Microsoft Purview. Then, the diagnostic calls the appropriate cmdlet that's listed in the following table ... Get-label ... Get-DlpCompliancePolicy

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Why it matters

claims.quote: Global Administrator ... Access to all administrative features in all Microsoft 365 services. ... Compliance Administrator ... manage eDiscovery cases, and maintain data governance policies ... Security Administrator ... managing security policies

claims.claim: Compliance Administrator and Security Administrator are Microsoft Entra roles displayed in Purview.

claims.quote: To manage members of a Microsoft Entra role, select Manage members in Microsoft Entra ID. This choice redirects you to the Azure management portal.

claims.claim: Learn documents no separate Purview setting to enable or disable self-help Diagnostics for a role.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Diagnostics turn off disable setting PowerShell; Purview Diagnostics Organization Management default enable disable. Opened self-help diagnostics, Purview permissions and Add-RoleGroupMember; results describe role requirements, not a separate self-help Diagnostics switch.

claims.claim: Role membership governs access to the documented diagnostics.
claims.quote: To run the Information Protection diagnostics, you need to have either of the following roles: ... To run the DLP diagnostics, you need to have any of the following roles: ... Organization Configuration

claims.claim: Nothing needs configuring for administrators holding the newly entitled roles to gain access.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview self-help diagnostics 500396 automatic rollout no action required Organization Management; Purview Diagnostics Organization Management default enable disable. Read the roadmap, self-help diagnostics and permissions pages; none states no configuration is required for this expansion.
claims.fix: Replace 'Administrators holding those roles gain access; nothing needs configuring, but check who holds them' with 'Microsoft has not stated the arrival default; check who holds these roles.' This also reconciles the summary with defaultState: unknown.

claims.claim: DLP diagnostics can be checked under Purview Solutions > Data Loss Prevention.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist asks readers to review Entra role membership, but the only control row explicitly covers Purview role groups instead.

claims.fix: The Before rollout instruction to review Compliance Administrator and Security Administrator in Microsoft Entra ID has no corresponding controls row; the existing row covers Purview role groups. Do not present that row as the Entra membership control.
